notes: REF-BM-02: extractMetadata collects title, description, favicon but not preview/og:image. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable, but no note field exists in the data model. REF-BM-06: saveBookmark always creates a new UUID entry with no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-10: tags are a free comma-separated text input with no autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-14: search is plain substring over joined fields; no #tag syntax (tags stored without #). REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised group parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: app has 'favorites' and 'archive' only; no unread/read-later flag, no unread view, no mark-as-read. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions on selection or filtered collection. REF-BM-23: no markdown note feature or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot and no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: Settings button is a dead stub; a working sort selector and grid/list view toggle provide some display adjustment but nothing is persisted and there is no font-size/displayed-items/default-sort settings profile.
